title: Eval harness fails samples whose provider override was not honoured (IMP-0017, operator-granted protected edit)
summary: Operator granted the protected-path edit to src/agent_os/orchestrator/eval.py for IMP-0017 on 2026-09-29 ("I grant the IMP 0017 edit to eval.py"). eval.call_route now passes every delegate outcome through check_override: when a passed, resolved sample was answered by a provider other than the route's provider, or by a model other than the route's pinned model, the sample becomes status override_not_honoured with its result discarded and an error naming the requested and actual provider:model (FND-0014). score_sample records no capability observation for such samples, because the answering provider did not fail and the requested one was not measured; the sample still counts as unscored in the route aggregate, so the EVR shows the route failed rather than silently borrowing another model's accuracy. Routes without a pinned model accept any model of the requested provider; unresolved or already-failed outcomes are unchanged. Scope limited to the granted file plus a new test module; no other protected path touched.
